description: Process source GIF frames or generate wave, orbit, pulse, noise, or palette-cycle motion. Export a GIF or PNG sprite sheet. GIF input defaults to source processing, which preserves frame count, delays, and loop count. Other input defaults to wave motion with 24 frames at 12 fps. Width defaults to 480 pixels when both dimensions are omitted or zero.

input.description: Read this local source relative to the workspace. Video expects a supported container. Other image operations use dither_catalog input_formats.

output.description: Create this output relative to the workspace. The path must not exist. Its extension selects the format unless format overrides it.

recipe.description: Load this saved JSON recipe relative to the workspace. A saved recipe must be used without inline options, palette, or colors.

palette.description: Choose a built-in palette ID. Use dither_palettes to discover IDs. Omit colors when this field is present.

colors.description: Supply 2 through 256 unique opaque hex colors instead of palette. Each color accepts RGB or RRGGBB with an optional leading #.

algorithm.description: Choose an algorithm ID from dither_catalog. Omission selects floyd-steinberg.

width.description: Set output width from 0 through 16384 pixels. Zero preserves source size or the aspect ratio when height is specified.

height.description: Set output height from 0 through 16384 pixels. Zero preserves source size or the aspect ratio when width is specified.

pixel_scale.description: Set grid scale from 0 through 256. Zero or one keeps the full grid. Larger values reduce the grid before dithering and enlarge it afterward.

resize_filter.description: Use bilinear or nearest sampling. Omission selects bilinear interpolation with correct alpha handling.

brightness.description: Add an sRGB channel offset from -1 through 1. The default is 0.

contrast.description: Set contrast from 0 through 4 around the channel midpoint 0.5. Omission selects 1. Zero produces a flat midpoint.

gamma.description: Set gamma from 0.1 through 8. The engine applies channel^(1/gamma). Omission selects 1.

saturation.description: Set saturation from 0 through 4. Omission selects 1. Zero produces grayscale.

threshold.description: Set threshold from 0 through 1. Omission selects 0.5. Higher values darken the quantization vector.

strength.description: Set dither strength from 0 through 2. Omission selects 1. Zero selects nearest-color quantization for ordered patterns.

seed.description: Use this integer seed for reproducible noise and moving effects. The default is 0.

serpentine.description: Reverse diffusion scan direction on alternate rows. The default is false.

invert.description: Invert RGB channels before dithering. Alpha remains unchanged.

grayscale.description: Convert RGB to grayscale before dithering. Alpha remains unchanged.

color_space.description: Use srgb or linear-rgb for palette distance and diffusion error. Omission selects srgb.

y.description: Set the nonnegative vertical crop origin within the source.

width.description: Set a positive crop width that fits wholly within the source.

height.description: Set a positive crop height that fits wholly within the source.

shape.description: Use rectangle, circle, or image. Image masks require a separate mask_input path in the request.

crt.description: Set CRT shading strength from 0 through 1.

noise.description: Set seeded additive noise strength from 0 through 1.

glitch.description: Set the maximum seeded horizontal row-band shift from 0 through 1024 pixels.

description: Search palettes by query, category, and color count. The result includes exact hex colors, descriptions, provenance, and tags in stable ID order. The default page size is 32. The maximum is 256. Use next_offset with the same filters for the next page. The categories array lists all categories.

query.description: Separate search terms with whitespace. Every term must match a substring in the palette metadata or hex colors. Matching ignores case. Searchable metadata includes ID, name, description, category, tags, and origin. The maximum length is 256 UTF-8 bytes.

category.description: The category slug must match exactly, ignoring case. Omit it to search every category. The response categories array lists available slugs.

min_colors.description: The inclusive minimum palette size is 2 through 256. Omission or zero selects 2.

max_colors.description: The inclusive maximum palette size is 2 through 256. It must be at least min_colors. Omission or zero selects 256.

limit.description: The page can contain at most this many palettes, from 1 through 256. Omission or zero selects 32.

offset.description: This nonnegative index selects a page from filtered results sorted by palette ID. Use next_offset from the previous response with the same filters. Offsets beyond the last result return an empty page.

name: dither_palettes

categories.description: This array lists all categories and their unfiltered library counts, sorted by category ID.

count.description: This is the number of palettes in this page.

matched.description: This is the number of palettes that match all filters before pagination.

next_offset.description: This index selects the next page under the same filters. The response omits it after the last page.

total.description: This is the number of palettes in the complete library.

saturation.description: Set saturation from 0 through 4. Omission selects 1. Zero produces grayscale.

seed.description: Use this integer seed for reproducible noise and moving effects. The default is 0.

serpentine.description: Reverse diffusion scan direction on alternate rows. The default is false.

strength.description: Set dither strength from 0 through 2. Omission selects 1. Zero selects nearest-color quantization for ordered patterns.

threshold.description: Set threshold from 0 through 1. Omission selects 0.5. Higher values darken the quantization vector.

width.description: Set output width from 0 through 16384 pixels. Zero preserves source size or the aspect ratio when height is specified.

palette.description: Select a built-in palette ID from dither_palettes. Omit colors when this field is present. Omission selects mono unless colors supplies a palette.

description: Process a bounded local MP4, MOV, WebM, Matroska, or AVI segment when local ffmpeg support is enabled. Export MP4, WebM, GIF, or a PNG sheet. The output contains no audio.

input.description: Read this local source relative to the workspace. Video expects a supported container. Other image operations use dither_catalog input_formats.

output.description: Create this output relative to the workspace. The path must not exist. Its extension selects the format unless format overrides it.

recipe.description: Load this saved JSON recipe relative to the workspace. A saved recipe must be used without inline options, palette, or colors.

palette.description: Choose a built-in palette ID. Use dither_palettes to discover IDs. Omit colors when this field is present.

colors.description: Supply 2 through 256 unique opaque hex colors instead of palette. Each color accepts RGB or RRGGBB with an optional leading #.

algorithm.description: Choose an algorithm ID from dither_catalog. Omission selects floyd-steinberg.

width.description: Set output width from 0 through 16384 pixels. Zero preserves source size or the aspect ratio when height is specified.

height.description: Set output height from 0 through 16384 pixels. Zero preserves source size or the aspect ratio when width is specified.

resize_filter.description: Use bilinear or nearest sampling. Omission selects bilinear interpolation with correct alpha handling.

brightness.description: Add an sRGB channel offset from -1 through 1. The default is 0.

contrast.description: Set contrast from 0 through 4 around the channel midpoint 0.5. Omission selects 1. Zero produces a flat midpoint.

gamma.description: Set gamma from 0.1 through 8. The engine applies channel^(1/gamma). Omission selects 1.

threshold.description: Set threshold from 0 through 1. Omission selects 0.5. Higher values darken the quantization vector.

seed.description: Use this integer seed for reproducible noise and moving effects. The default is 0.

serpentine.description: Reverse diffusion scan direction on alternate rows. The default is false.

invert.description: Invert RGB channels before dithering. Alpha remains unchanged.

grayscale.description: Convert RGB to grayscale before dithering. Alpha remains unchanged.

color_space.description: Use srgb or linear-rgb for palette distance and diffusion error. Omission selects srgb.

x.description: Set the nonnegative horizontal crop origin within the source.

y.description: Set the nonnegative vertical crop origin within the source.

width.description: Set a positive crop width that fits wholly within the source.

height.description: Set a positive crop height that fits wholly within the source.

crop.description: Crop within source bounds before resizing. Service inputs use upright coordinates after EXIF orientation, with a top-left origin.

shape.description: Use rectangle, circle, or image. Image masks require a separate mask_input path in the request.

x.description: Set the rectangle left edge or circle center on the reduced grid.

y.description: Set the rectangle top edge or circle center on the reduced grid.

width.description: Set a positive rectangle width in reduced-grid pixels.

height.description: Set a positive rectangle height in reduced-grid pixels.

radius.description: Set a circle radius from 1 through 16384 reduced-grid pixels.

invert.description: Dither the complement of this selection. The default is false.

mask.description: Dither only selected pixels on the reduced grid. Pixels outside the selection retain their adjusted source values.

scanlines.description: Set scanline shading strength from 0 through 1.

scanline_spacing.description: Set scanline spacing from 0 through 256 pixels. Omission or zero selects 2.

crt.description: Set CRT shading strength from 0 through 1.

noise.description: Set seeded additive noise strength from 0 through 1.

glitch.description: Set the maximum seeded horizontal row-band shift from 0 through 1024 pixels.

pixel_sort.description: Sort visible contiguous luminance runs above pixel_sort_threshold.

pixel_sort_threshold.description: Set the pixel-sorting threshold from 0 through 1. Omission selects 0.25.

effects.description: Apply these effects after dithering. Shading and noise may produce colors outside the palette.

options.description: Apply these engine settings. A saved recipe cannot be combined with inline options.

mask_input.description: Read and normalize this local mask relative to the workspace. EXIF orientation and supported color declarations apply before luminance times alpha >= 0.5 selects pixels on the reduced grid.

format.description: Override the output extension. Still output supports png, jpeg, gif, svg, pbm, or ascii. Animation supports gif or png. Video supports mp4, webm, gif, or png. Separations use zip.

dpi.description: Set PNG print metadata from 36 through 2400 DPI. Omission or zero leaves metadata unspecified. Animation and video require zero.

fps.description: Sample 1 through 50 frames per second. Omission or zero selects 12.

frames.description: Set a limit of 1 through 120 processed frames. Omission or zero selects 48. A shorter input segment can return fewer frames.

start.description: Start the local video segment at this time in seconds, from 0 through 86400. Omission starts at zero.
